note: Per-stage timings from instrumented BundleRecommender.recommend(). Cold = distinct customers (no LRU hit). n=20 customers, seed=42, real bundle.

http_overhead.note: HTTP loopback adds serialization and FastAPI routing on top of BundleRecommender direct timing.

budget.note: Cold no-reasons p95=52ms is under 150ms budget. Dominant stage: feature_assembly (mean 38.1ms of 49.1ms total).

num_threads_comparison.note: booster.predict(X, num_threads=N) on 200x68 float32 matrix with 30% NaN (mimics cold-customer sparsity).
num_threads_comparison.interpretation: n_jobs=4 (saved in model file) gives 3.7x SHAP speedup: 1118ms (1 thread) -> 299ms (4 threads). Without n_jobs=4, cold with-reasons = ~50ms + 1118ms = ~1168ms, above the 700ms budget.

capacity_math.note: 4 workers x 4 SHAP threads = 16 concurrent SHAP threads on 8 cores => 2x oversubscription during SHAP at full load.
